Subject: Offer approval: SDE3 — Samuel Ortiz (base/bonus/equity)

Team —

Attaching a draft offer for Samuel Ortiz (SDE3, remote - US) and requesting quick committee sign-off so we can hit his target start window (Aug 4). Summary of the proposed economics:

- Base salary: $170,000
- Target bonus: 15% (annual, performance-based)
- Equity: 0.25% RSU, 4y vesting (25% one-year cliff)
- Sign-on: $20,000 (paid over first two payrolls)
- Req/charge code: HR-Req-#4521 (open headcount / approved by People Ops)

Context: Sam is currently at a late-stage startup at $155k + 10% bonus + 0.12% equity. He’s got strong infra experience and multiple offers in the $160–175k base range. We positioned toward the top of band to be competitive and keep total comp near our midpoint targets for SDE3.

Please review the attached "offer_package_Samuel_Ortiz_v2.pdf" and confirm any changes to base/bonus/equity/sign-on. If there are no objections I’ll instruct Greenlight to send the formal offer today with a 7-day response window.

Thanks,
Jonas

Subject: Re: Offer approval: SDE3 — Samuel Ortiz (base/bonus/equity)

Jonas —

Thanks for the packet. Quick thoughts:

- Base looks right for the market. Happy to approve $170k if we can shift a touch of comp from sign-on into equity to improve retention.
- Recommend equity 0.30% instead of 0.25% (small bump, keeps OTE reasonable).
- If we increase equity, we can consider reducing sign-on to $12k (still competitive and reduces one-time cash burden).
- Bonus at 15% is fine but confirm performance target and payout schedule in the offer language.

If Evelyn is okay with the comp trade, I can sign off today.

Laura

Subject: Re: Offer approval: SDE3 — Samuel Ortiz (base/bonus/equity)

Hi all —

I reviewed comp band L4/L5 guidance and Samuel’s current comp. Attached is the comp_approval_matrix.csv with band ranges and allowable flex. Our recommendations to remain within pay philosophy and budget:

- Final base: $168,000 (top of L4 midpoint but below L5 floor)
- Target bonus: 12% (we can keep 15% as stretch but recommend 12% as standard target for this hire)
- Equity: 0.30% (OK to increase from 0.25% per Laura)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (one-time)

Rationale: The slight reduction in base to $168k offsets the equity bump; this maintains total target comp within the approved band and preserves room for future promotions/raises. We also want to avoid setting a precedence with a $20k sign-on for this level.

Headcount/finance: Please note charge code HR-Req-#4521 will be charged to Platform Eng headcount bucket — Markus, confirm org budget is OK.

If the team confirms, I will record the approval in the HR system and generate the formal offer template language (including explicit bonus target, payout mechanics, and standard RSU grant agreement references).

Evelyn
